		#{italic}#Hot, steamy maiming!#{normal}#

successful melee hit and living target and positive scalar -> FIREBURN projector
scalar FIREBURN -> complete incoming event total with default dur=3 and initial=50
directional_numeric_value_flow.displayed_quantity: complete incoming FIREBURN event amount over the named three turns, before downstream mitigation

directional_numeric_value_flow.tooltip_scalar: self.dam resolved from resolvers.clscale(90, 30, 25, 0.75, 0) for the fire instance
flow: self.dam -> hit projection using instance damtype DamageType.FIREBURN
scalar FIREBURN -> complete incoming event total with default dur=3 and initial=50
directional_numeric_value_flow.displayed_quantity: generic trap scalar; for the fire instance it is the complete incoming FIREBURN event amount

directional_numeric_value_flow.tooltip_scalar: self.dam resolved from resolvers.clscale(200, 50, 50, 0.75, 80) for the fire blast instance
flow: self.radius=2 -> ball projection radius and description argument 4 -> final %d
self.dam -> ball projection using instance damtype DamageType.FIREBURN
scalar FIREBURN -> complete incoming event total with default dur=3 and initial=50
directional_numeric_value_flow.displayed_quantity: generic blast scalar and runtime radius; for the fire instance the scalar is the complete incoming FIREBURN event amount and radius is 2

scalar_fireburn.burning_power: (D/2) / 3 = D/6 per timeout before downstream mitigation
scalar_fireburn.unmerged_nominal_total: D/2 immediate plus three D/6 timeouts equals incoming D

successful_hit_relation.binding: Only then does Combat.lua iterate self.melee_project and invoke the FIREBURN projector for positive Overheat Saws damage.
successful_hit_relation.wording_consequence: The existing 对近战攻击命中的目标 wording is source- and runtime-faithful.

burning_merge_qualification.condition: an EFF_BURNING effect already exists and on_merge runs
burning_merge_qualification.conservation: old remaining damage plus the new remaining contribution is pooled before downstream mitigation
burning_merge_qualification.wording_consequence: 可以叠加 is supported, but the newly applied contribution is not guaranteed to retain an isolated three-tick schedule after merge.

radius_template.fire_blast_relation: The fire blast instance binds self.radius=2; the trigger and description also share the fallback value 2.

fire_instance_dynamic_name.binding: dtype.name fills the third formatter placeholder, so the generic fire-trap surface carries 火焰燃烧 without hardcoding FIREBURN-only duration wording.

generic_trap_runtime.shared_template_limitation: The same two locale templates render non-FIREBURN damage types; adding a three-turn FIREBURN duration would make those generic surfaces false.

decisions.reason: The target already binds the total to melee-hit targets and three turns; BURNING merge supports 可以叠加.
The template is polymorphic and its dynamic localized damage-type argument already supplies 火焰燃烧 for the fire instance; no FIREBURN-only duration may be hardcoded.

CTX-TYPED-R0-001 was resolved by the user in favor of explicit radius wording. At the pinned core commit, the fourth placeholder is bound to self.radius or 2 in the description and the same value controls the ball projection radius, so 半径 %d states the typed runtime quantity explicitly.
